summary:
Satellite active-fire counts jump artificially by 4.7×–14.0× whenever newer 375 m VIIRS satellites (S-NPP, NOAA-20, NOAA-21) join 1 km MODIS (Terra & Aqua), distorting long-term climate and haze trends. Across 43.7 million real NASA FIRMS detections (2000–2026) in Southeast Asia, our 4-era physics-informed calibration pipeline eliminates sensor discontinuities (out-of-time holdout R² = 0.9690, Spearman ρ = 0.9864; step-change reduced from 6.902× to 0.762×) and powers a live interactive split-screen burning calendar (https://nasachallenge-production-283ffe54.up.railway.app
) with custom polygon analytics, H3 density mapping, and live FIRMS NRT sync
details: NASA FIRMS Harmonized Burning Activity Calendar (2001–2026) transforms 43,713,900 raw MODIS and VIIRS active-fire detections (2000–2026) across Southeast Asia into 37,739,296 validated vegetation fire records, eliminating artificial 6.9×–14.0× satellite jumps caused by merging 1 km MODIS (Terra/Aqua) with 375 m VIIRS (Suomi NPP, NOAA-20, NOAA-21). Our 4-era physics-informed pipeline applies a 47,316-cell static thermal mask (removing 1.94 million volcano, smelter, and flare detections), pixel-area and sub-MODIS covariates, 1 km daily footprint clustering, multi-VIIRS stream equalization, and an Empirical CDF Quantile Matching + HistGradientBoostingRegressor ensemble with post-2022 orbital-drift tapering—achieving an out-of-time holdout R² = 0.9690 (Spearman ρ = 0.9864) and reducing the raw 6.902× step-change to 0.762× (matching the true 0.758× MODIS trend). Built with Python, FastAPI, DuckDB, PyArrow, Scikit-Learn, Uber H3, Leaflet, Apache ECharts, Tailwind CSS, Docker, and Railway (with live NASA FIRMS NRT sync, NASA GIBS imagery, and Open-Meteo/RainViewer weather layers; assisted by Google DeepMind Antigravity AI), the split-screen console lets policymakers and researchers toggle Raw vs. Harmonized views, inspect 26-year Monthly/Weekly/Daily calendars with 95% confidence intervals and CVD-safe palettes, and draw any custom polygon in ASEAN for sub-150 ms re-harmonization to support accurate haze and peatland-fire decisions.
